definitions.gloss: non-urgent; not pressing; not immediately necessary
definitions.explanation: Describing something that does not require immediate attention or action. Almost always used in the pair {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}.

examples.japanese: {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧。
{不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧はやめましょう。

⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}{事態|じたい}→緊急事態：16936_kinkyuujitai⟧⟦{宣言|せんげん}→宣言：12284_sengen⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{移動|いどう}→移動：01741_idou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自粛|じしゅく}→自粛：07650_jishuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦{呼|よ}びかけられた→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
examples.english: During the state of emergency, people were urged to refrain from nonessential travel.

notes:
USAGE:
Rarely used alone; almost always appears in the four-character compound {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう} (nonessential and non-urgent). This phrase became widely known during the COVID-19 pandemic when the Japanese government repeatedly called on citizens to avoid {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧ (nonessential outings)
- {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{移動|いどう}→移動：01741_idou⟧ (nonessential travel)
- {不要|ふよう}{不急|ふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{用事|ようじ}→用事：01520_youji⟧ (nonessential errands)
